api_tokens_board_ids.name: api_tokens_board_ids
api_tokens_board_ids.value: "api_tokens"."board_ids" is null or cardinality("api_tokens"."board_ids") between 1 and 100

board_automations_kind_fields.name: board_automations_kind_fields
board_automations_kind_fields.value:
case "board_automations"."kind"::text
    when 'archive_done' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null and "board_automations"."priority" is null and "board_automations"."target_column_id" is null
    when 'tag_stale' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is not null and "board_automations"."priority" is null and "board_automations"."target_column_id" is null
    when 'notify_stale' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null and "board_automations"."priority" is null and "board_automations"."target_column_id" is null
    when 'raise_priority' then "board_automations"."days" between 0 and 365 and "board_automations"."priority" is not null and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null and "board_automations"."target_column_id" is null
    when 'move_card' then "board_automations"."days" between 1 and 365 and "board_automations"."tag_id" is null and "board_automations"."priority" is null
      and ("board_automations"."column_id" is not null or "board_automations"."card_id" is not null) and "board_automations"."target_column_id" is not null and "board_automations"."target_column_id" is distinct from "board_automations"."column_id"
    else false
  end

board_buttons_tooltip_length.name: board_buttons_tooltip_length
board_buttons_tooltip_length.value: "board_buttons"."tooltip" is null or char_length("board_buttons"."tooltip") between 1 and 200

board_buttons_steps_shape.name: board_buttons_steps_shape
board_buttons_steps_shape.value: jsonb_typeof("board_buttons"."steps") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("board_buttons"."steps") between 1 and 10 and pg_column_size("board_buttons"."steps") < 16384

board_rules_event_fields.name: board_rules_event_fields
board_rules_event_fields.value: ("board_rules"."event_tag_id" is null or "board_rules"."event"::text = 'tag_added') and ("board_rules"."event_user_id" is null or "board_rules"."event"::text = 'assigned')

board_rules_has_action.name: board_rules_has_action
board_rules_has_action.value:
"board_rules"."move_column_id" is not null or "board_rules"."add_tag_id" is not null or "board_rules"."remove_tag_id" is not null
    or "board_rules"."assign_user_id" is not null or "board_rules"."set_priority" is not null or "board_rules"."set_due_days" is not null or "board_rules"."archive"

board_rules_tags_differ.name: board_rules_tags_differ
board_rules_tags_differ.value: "board_rules"."add_tag_id" is distinct from "board_rules"."remove_tag_id" or "board_rules"."add_tag_id" is null

boards_background_shape.name: boards_background_shape
boards_background_shape.value:
"boards"."background" is null
    or ("boards"."background"->>'kind' = 'color' and "boards"."background"->>'value' ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
    or ("boards"."background"->>'kind' in ('gradient', 'photo', 'upload') and "boards"."background"->>'value' ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$')

boards_column_outline_shape.name: boards_column_outline_shape
boards_column_outline_shape.value:
"boards"."column_outline" is null or (
    jsonb_typeof("boards"."column_outline") = 'object'
    and "boards"."column_outline" ?& array['color', 'width', 'glow']
    and "boards"."column_outline" - 'color' - 'width' - 'glow' = '{}'::jsonb
    and ("boards"."column_outline"->'color' = 'null'::jsonb or "boards"."column_outline"->>'color' in ('accent', 'column') or "boards"."column_outline"->>'color' ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
    and "boards"."column_outline"->'width' in ('1', '2', '3', '4')
    and "boards"."column_outline"->'glow' in ('0', '1', '2', '3'))

card_comments_imported_author.name: card_comments_imported_author
card_comments_imported_author.value: "card_comments"."imported_author" is null or ("card_comments"."author_id" is null and length("card_comments"."imported_author") between 1 and 100)

card_recurrences_rule_fields.name: card_recurrences_rule_fields
card_recurrences_rule_fields.value:
case "card_recurrences"."rule"::text
    when 'daily' then "card_recurrences"."weekdays" is null and "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" is null
    when 'weekly' then "card_recurrences"."weekdays" is not null and cardinality("card_recurrences"."weekdays") between 1 and 7 and "card_recurrences"."weekdays" <@ '{1,2,3,4,5,6,7}'::smallint[] and "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" is null
    when 'monthly' then "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" is not null and "card_recurrences"."day_of_month" between 1 and 31 and "card_recurrences"."weekdays" is null
    else false
  end

card_reminders_shape.name: card_reminders_shape
card_reminders_shape.value:
("card_reminders"."before_due_days" is null and "card_reminders"."due_time" is null and "card_reminders"."time_zone" is null and "card_reminders"."remind_at" is not null)
    or ("card_reminders"."before_due_days" between 0 and 365 and "card_reminders"."due_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "card_reminders"."time_zone" is not null)

card_scheduled_actions_kind_fields.name: card_scheduled_actions_kind_fields
card_scheduled_actions_kind_fields.value:
case "card_scheduled_actions"."kind"
    when 'move' then "card_scheduled_actions"."target_column_id" is not null and "card_scheduled_actions"."priority" is null and "card_scheduled_actions"."note" is null
    when 'priority' then "card_scheduled_actions"."priority" is not null and "card_scheduled_actions"."target_column_id" is null and "card_scheduled_actions"."note" is null
    when 'archive' then "card_scheduled_actions"."target_column_id" is null and "card_scheduled_actions"."priority" is null and "card_scheduled_actions"."note" is null
    when 'remind' then "card_scheduled_actions"."target_column_id" is null and "card_scheduled_actions"."priority" is null and coalesce(char_length("card_scheduled_actions"."note"), 0) <= 500
    else false
  end

column_rules_one_mover_per_column.name: column_rules_one_mover_per_column
column_rules_one_mover_per_column.where: "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null

column_rules_kind_fields.name: column_rules_kind_fields
column_rules_kind_fields.value:
case "column_rules"."kind"::text
    when 'apply_tag' then "column_rules"."tag_id" is not null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null
    when 'remove_tag' then "column_rules"."tag_id" is not null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null
    when 'assign_to' then "column_rules"."user_id" is not null and "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null
    when 'set_due' then "column_rules"."due_days" between 0 and 365 and "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null
    when 'assign_mover' then "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null
    when 'add_button' then "column_rules"."button_id" is not null and "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null
    when 'remove_button' then "column_rules"."button_id" is not null and "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null
    when 'mark_completed' then "column_rules"."tag_id" is null and "column_rules"."user_id" is null and "column_rules"."due_days" is null and "column_rules"."button_id" is null
    else false
  end

columns_outline_shape.name: columns_outline_shape
columns_outline_shape.value:
"columns"."outline" is null or (
    jsonb_typeof("columns"."outline") = 'object'
    and "columns"."outline" ?& array['color', 'width', 'glow']
    and "columns"."outline" - 'color' - 'width' - 'glow' = '{}'::jsonb
    and ("columns"."outline"->'color' = 'null'::jsonb or "columns"."outline"->>'color' in ('accent', 'column') or "columns"."outline"->>'color' ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
    and "columns"."outline"->'width' in ('1', '2', '3', '4')
    and "columns"."outline"->'glow' in ('0', '1', '2', '3'))

    or ("custom_views"."background"->>'kind' = 'color' and "custom_views"."background"->>'value' ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
    or ("custom_views"."background"->>'kind' in ('gradient', 'photo', 'upload') and "custom_views"."background"->>'value' ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$')

custom_views_column_outline_shape.name: custom_views_column_outline_shape

    jsonb_typeof("custom_views"."column_outline") = 'object'
    and "custom_views"."column_outline" ?& array['color', 'width', 'glow']
    and "custom_views"."column_outline" - 'color' - 'width' - 'glow' = '{}'::jsonb
    and ("custom_views"."column_outline"->'color' = 'null'::jsonb or "custom_views"."column_outline"->>'color' in ('accent', 'column') or "custom_views"."column_outline"->>'color' ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
    and "custom_views"."column_outline"->'width' in ('1', '2', '3', '4')
    and "custom_views"."column_outline"->'glow' in ('0', '1', '2', '3'))

push_subscriptions_keys.name: push_subscriptions_keys
push_subscriptions_keys.value: char_length("push_subscriptions"."p256dh") between 80 and 100 and char_length("push_subscriptions"."auth") between 16 and 40
